Scope and uncertainty

January 2022 first-phase snapshot: 760 DGX A100 systems / 6,080 GPUs. Later expansion plans are not counted as installed hardware. CPU and on-node links follow the documented DGX A100 platform; installed memory variant is not published. Node specifications follow the documented NVIDIA DGX A100 platform (6U rackmount); operator-specific deviations are not published.
